text:
mia_sales: CobaltBank POC kickoff — they need low-latency streaming (SSE or WS), function/tool-calls for KYC extraction, strict JSON schema, SAML SSO + customer KMS, and a monthly estimate for reserved vs hosted. Can eng deliver runnable samples in 48h?

dev_igor: Yes. We'll provide a Node WS and Python SSE sample plus a tiny replay driver to simulate ~800-1k QPS. Minimal WS demo: ```js
ws.send(JSON.stringify({input:'extract_kyc',stream:true}));
```

sam_se: For structured output use function-calls + JSON Schema. Show a validator and a 422 error shape: {"error":{"code":"SCHEMA_MISMATCH","path":"/data/id_number","expected":"string"}}

ana_ops: I'll provision a reserved sandbox (AWS CMK) and run perf tests once samples land. Need links by EOD.

dev_igor: Ops config we'll demo: batching.max_delay_ms=20, prefix_cache=true, fallback -> lower-cost variant with header `x-redwood-fallback: true`. Ephemeral API tokens recommended (TTL 15m).

legal_bot: Please send the security questionnaire to legal@redwood.ai. Upload link for Cobalt: https://onetrust.example.com/cobalt-upload. They asked for SOC2, KMS controls, and data residency notes.

deploy_bot: Sandbox created: sandbox-cobalt-01. Endpoint: https://sandbox.redwood.ai/cobalt

mia_sales: Plan: collect Cobalt sample prompts today, perf numbers tomorrow AM, live demo 3pm PT. Procurement wants a quick ballpark.

dev_igor: Quick ballpark: reserved pool (~4x A100 eq) ~ "$32k/mo"; hosted autoscale with batching ~ "$19k/mo". I'll deliver a token-based calc tomorrow.

sam_se: Demo tip: show deterministic function signature + auto-retry flow when schema fails so integrators can map errors to UX decisions.
